description: Update an insight (a FINDING) — set its status, or edit its content. Allowed status: open / addressed / superseded / dismissed. Note: you normally don't set 'addressed' by hand — that happens automatically when set_intervention links this finding to a shipped fix. An insight carries NO fix verdict; 'did it work' lives on the linked intervention (see get_interventions). Use this to dismiss/supersede a finding, edit its text/tags, or attach evidence snapshots.

addTags.description: Append these tags to the existing set without removing others. Useful for adding workflow tags like 'fix-applied' or '30-day-check' without overwriting.

completed.description: (Legacy) Mark as completed. Setting true without a status sets status='addressed'; false sets status='open'.

delete.description: Remove this insight entirely — use when the user says it's not relevant or not an issue

dismissed.description: (Legacy) Mark as dismissed. Setting this to true without a status sets status='dismissed'.

linkSnapshotIds.description: Attach existing metric snapshots (record_metric_snapshot rows) to this insight as supporting evidence for the finding. Pass the snapshotIds (returned from query_metric_snapshots). The snapshots appear in get_insights(report: 'thread') timelines. Use this when snapshots were recorded without insightId — typical when you only learn the insight ID after saving.

notes.description: Free-text note about this finding. Stored alongside the insight for future reference.

parentInsightId.description: Link this insight to a predecessor. The threadId is auto-managed: if the parent has one, it's inherited; otherwise a fresh threadId is generated and applied to both. Pass an empty string to detach the parent (and clear threadId if no other thread members reference it).

removeTags.description: Remove these tags from the existing set, leaving others intact.

status.description: Workflow state. Setting status auto-syncs the legacy completed/dismissed mirror booleans.

tags.description: Replace the insight's tags with this list (e.g. ['seo','fix-applied']). Pass [] to clear all tags.

threadId.description: Set or change this insight's threadId directly. Use empty string to clear.

unlinkSnapshotIds.description: Detach the given snapshotIds from this insight (sets their insightId to null). Use to correct a wrong link.

name: update_insight
title: Update an insight
